tasks.title: Create the JSON-backed todo store with tests
tasks.description: Create src/todo-store.js holding all file I/O and all formatting of a todo, so the CLI layer in src/todo.js stays side-effect free. Storage format: `.todos.json` at a directory root, holding an array of `{ id, text, done }` objects. A missing file reads as an empty list; ids are per-file 1-based and never reused.

edits.change:
Write an ES module that imports `readFile`/`writeFile`/`mkdir` from `node:fs/promises` and `join` from `node:path`.

Export `export const CHECK_MARK = '✓'`.

Export `export function storePath(dir) { return join(dir, '.todos.json') }`.

Export `export async function readTodos(dir)`: read `storePath(dir)`; if the call rejects with `err.code === 'ENOENT'` return `[]`; otherwise parse the JSON and return the parsed array (on unreadable/corrupt JSON throw an Error whose message mentions the file path).

Export `export async function writeTodos(dir, todos)`: `await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true })` then `await writeFile(storePath(dir), JSON.stringify(todos, null, 2) + '\n', 'utf8')`.

Export `export async function addTodo(dir, text)`: read, compute `nextId` as the maximum existing numeric `id` plus 1 (or 1 when the list is empty), push `{ id: nextId, text, done: false }`, write, and return the new todo object.

Export `export async function completeTodo(dir, id)`: read; find the entry with that `id`; if not found return `null` without writing; otherwise set `done = true`, write, and return the updated todo object.

Export `export async function deleteTodo(dir, id)`: read; if no entry has that id return `null` without writing; otherwise splice it out, write, and return the deleted todo object.

Export `export function formatTodo(todo)`: return `` `${todo.done ? CHECK_MARK : ' '} ${todo.id}. ${todo.text}` `` (done items get the ✓ prefix, pending items get a single space).

Export `export function renderList(todos, { pendingOnly = false } = {})`: return the string produced by filtering out done todos when `pendingOnly` is true and then `todos.map(formatTodo).join('\n')`, which is `''` for an empty list.

node:test file using `import { test } from 'node:test'`, `import assert from 'node:assert/strict'`, `import { mkdtemp, readFile, rm } from 'node:fs/promises'`, and `pathToFileURL` from `node:url`. Build every temp dir with a helper `makeTempDir()` = `(await mkdtemp(pathToFileURL(import.meta.dirname + '/tmp/todo-store-'))).pathname`, register cleanup with `t.after(() => rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }))`, and never touch the project-root `.todos.json`.

5. `completeTodo` on an unknown id 999 returns `null` and leaves the stored array unchanged.
6. `deleteTodo(dir, 1)` returns the deleted todo and leaves only the second todo in the store.
7. `deleteTodo` on an unknown id 999 returns `null` and leaves the stored array unchanged.
8. `writeTodos` then `readTodos` round-trips, and reading the raw file with `readFile(join(dir, '.todos.json'), 'utf8')` shows JSON containing `"done": false`.
9. `formatTodo({ id: 1, text: 'buy milk', done: true })` starts with '✓' while the pending form starts with a space and contains '1. buy milk'.
10. `renderList([{ id: 1, text: 'a', done: false }, { id: 2, text: 'b', done: true }])` contains both '1. a' and '✓ 2. b'; the same call with `{ pendingOnly: true }` contains '1. a' but not 'b' and not '✓'.

tasks.title: Create the todo CLI (parser, commands, entry point) with tests
tasks.description: Create src/todo.js: `parseArgs(argv)` performs no file access at all, while `runCommand(argv, io)` returns the exact stdout string for `add <text>`, `list`, `list --pending`, `done <id>` and `remove <id>`. It is imported by src/bin/todo.js, which supplies the real stdout, stderr and exit code. Unknown commands or missing arguments return a usage string that bin/todo.js prints to stderr with exit code 1.

edits.change:
ES module. Import `pathToFileURL` from `node:url` and `resolve` from `node:path`, and import `readTodos, addTodo, completeTodo, deleteTodo, renderList` from `./todo-store.js`.

Export `export function defaultDataDir() { return pathToFileURL(process.cwd() + '/').pathname }` — process.cwd() already ends in a slash, and pathToFileURL().pathname is the plain filesystem path, so it behaves correctly on platforms where the path contains characters such as spaces.

Export `export const USAGE` — a multi-line string listing exactly `todo add <text>`, `todo list [--pending]`, `todo done <id>` and `todo remove <id>`, one command per line.

Export `export function parseArgs(argv)`: return `{ command, text, id, pendingOnly, error }`. `command` is the first element or null; `text` is every remaining argument after `add` joined with a single space; `id` is `Number.parseInt` of the argument after `done` or `remove` (NaN when it is missing or not an integer); `pendingOnly` is true only when `argv` includes `--pending`; `error` is a short message set for these cases — command not in the set → 'Unknown command: <command>'; `add` with empty text → 'todo add requires text'; `done`/`remove` with a NaN id → 'todo <command> requires a numeric id'. When `error` is set the other fields are irrelevant.

Export `export async function runCommand(argv, io = {})`: read `const dir = io.dir ?? defaultDataDir()`, call `parseArgs(argv)` and return `USAGE` early when `io.error` is set. Then switch on `io.command`:
- `add`: `const todo = await addTodo(dir, io.text)`; return `Added ${todo.id}: ${todo.text}`.
- `list`: `const todos = await readTodos(dir)`; return `renderList(todos, { pendingOnly: io.pendingOnly })` — exactly that string, empty when nothing matches, so `list` prints nothing and exits 0 when there are no todos.
- `done`: `const todo = await completeTodo(dir, io.id)`; return todo ? `Done ${todo.id}: ${todo.text}` : `No todo with id ${io.id}`.
- `remove`: `const todo = await deleteTodo(dir, io.id)`; return todo ? `Removed ${todo.id}: ${todo.text}` : `No todo with id ${io.id}`.
and return `USAGE` if the command is null or unrecognised.

Export `export function resolveDataDir(env = process.env)`: return `env.TODO_DIR ? resolve(env.TODO_DIR) : defaultDataDir()`.

Executable entry point. Import `runCommand, resolveDataDir, USAGE` from '../todo.js'. Read `const out = await runCommand(process.argv.slice(2), { dir: resolveDataDir() })`. If the returned string equals `USAGE`, write it plus a newline to `process.stderr` and call `process.exit(1)`; otherwise write the string plus a newline to `process.stdout` and exit 0.

contracts.statement: src/todo-store.js is the only module that touches the filesystem. It stores todos as a JSON array of `{ "id": <integer starting at 1, never reused within a file>, "text": <string>, "done": <boolean> }` objects, written as pretty-printed JSON (2-space indent) with a trailing newline to `<dir>/.todos.json`. A missing file reads as an empty array. Exported API: `CHECK_MARK` ('✓'), `storePath(dir)`, `readTodos(dir)`, `writeTodos(dir, todos)`, `addTodo(dir, text)`, `completeTodo(dir, id)`, `deleteTodo(dir, id)`, `formatTodo(todo)`, `renderList(todos, { pendingOnly })`.

src/todo.js exports `parseArgs(argv)` returning `{ command, text, id, pendingOnly, error }` (error is null when the argv is valid) and `runCommand(argv, io)` where io is `{ dir }`; runCommand returns exactly the string that bin/todo.js prints followed by a newline — no trailing newline inside the returned string. Output strings: add -> `Added <id>: <text>`; list -> the renderList output (empty string when nothing to show); done -> `Done <id>: <text>` or `No todo with id <id>`; remove -> `Removed <id>: <text>` or `No todo with id <id>`; any parse error or unknown command -> the exported `USAGE` constant, which bin/todo.js writes to stderr and exits 1 on. When io.dir is not supplied runCommand defaults to resolveDataDir().

The directory holding `.todos.json` is the value of the `TODO_DIR` environment variable when it is set and non-empty, otherwise the current working directory. Both the default and the env override are plain filesystem paths, never file:// URLs (temp directories created by the tests are passed to runCommand as such paths).
